title: Translate all hardcoded Portuguese UI strings to English (admin panel + public docs)
description: Address item 13 of `novas-tasks.md`, explicitly scheduled as the last task of this batch since earlier tasks (TASK-100..110) add or change UI copy that would otherwise need retranslating. Per user decision, this is a direct literal translation of hardcoded strings, not a new i18n framework — the product becomes English-only with no language switcher. No i18n abstraction currently exists (confirmed: no `i18next`/`react-intl`/`next-intl`, no `strings.ts`/locale files); roughly 37 of 46 `.tsx` files under `apps/admin/src` contain inline Portuguese text (labels, button text, toasts, confirm dialogs, placeholders, aria-labels, empty states). Translate all user-facing strings in the admin panel and the public documentation views to English. Do NOT rename database/domain fields (`titulo`, `ordem`, `senha_hash`, etc.) — `CLAUDE.md` documents these Portuguese domain names as an intentional convention; only user-visible copy changes. Server-side user-facing error messages that surface in the UI (e.g. tRPC error messages shown in toasts) are in scope; internal code comments and variable names are not.
acceptanceCriteria: No hardcoded Portuguese string remains in any user-visible admin panel UI (buttons, labels, headings, empty states, confirm dialogs, toasts, tooltips, aria-labels)
No hardcoded Portuguese string remains in the public documentation views (`/docs/*` routes)
Server-side error messages that are displayed to the user in the UI are in English; internal/log-only messages are out of scope
Database schema field names, migration file contents, and code identifiers are unchanged — only literal UI copy is translated
`CLAUDE.md`'s documented Portuguese domain-naming convention is left intact and not contradicted by this task

steps.details: Grep across `apps/admin/src` (and any user-facing server error strings) for accented/Portuguese-word patterns to build a complete file list beyond the ~26-37 files already identified.
Go file by file translating literal JSX text, button labels, toast/alert messages, confirm dialogs, and placeholders to English.
Translate any hardcoded Portuguese copy in the public `/docs/*` view components (chrome around the rendered content, not user-authored documentation content itself, which is out of scope).
Update tRPC error messages that are shown directly to the user (e.g. CONFLICT/FORBIDDEN messages surfaced in toasts) to English, leaving internal-only error text untouched.
Click through every admin screen and the public docs, confirming all visible text is in English; run `pnpm typecheck`/`lint`/`test` across affected packages.

technicalNotes: Addresses item 13 of `novas-tasks.md` — user explicitly requested this run last, after the other items in this batch, since they change/add UI copy that would need retranslating otherwise.
Per user decision: literal translation only, no i18n framework, no language switcher.
Status tag values (To do, In progress, Deprecated, Beta, from TASK-106) and slash-command block names (from TASK-104) are already in English from their respective tasks — no rework needed here.

Large surface area (~37/46 admin `.tsx` files) — consider splitting execution by area (navigation, editor, auth/users, public docs) if a single pass proves too large, but keep it one task/PR per the user's 'last task' framing unless it becomes unwieldy.
